subject: Bounded APC metadata transactions and immutable session accounting
source: Original implementation following local I/O ownership cross-review; no external code mined
modifications: Retain the physical payload byte total measured by the bounded spill worker or startup rescan in the entry's disk receipt.
Use that immutable size for session status and pin admission without path discovery or stat under the APC lock.
Do not silently free disk reservations when an external actor removes a payload; exact-byte restore validation detects corruption and ordinary entry removal releases ownership.

Move manifest write/fsync/replace/temporary cleanup, payload deletion/discovery/fsync and failed-spill cleanup to one bounded pure-I/O worker over immutable host snapshots. Never evaluate MLX or take the APC lock on this worker.

Expose typed apc_persistence_indeterminate timeout and apc_persistence_incomplete deletion failures with readable metadata transaction receipts. Poison the owner, prohibit further cache/session/prefetch mutation and require reload; do not claim the durable operation was cancelled.

Retain payload paths, physical byte charge and persistent directory lock until actual syscall/worker completion. Late durable publication is explicitly ambiguous, never credited to the current request.

Close device state on the caller/model thread; register detached writers before waiting and release the persistent lock only after every metadata/spill worker drains. Repeated/concurrent close is safe.
Preserve unvisited spill jobs when manifest publication fails and reject queued prefetch mutation after poisoning.
Count freed bytes only after successful unlink and refuse successful deletion receipts if files remain or absence cannot be established.

validation.new_regressions: Metadata, actual HTTP park/delete, concurrent close, pending prefetch and failed-unlink accounting
covers: failed unlink accounting and incomplete deletion receipts
APC lifecycle, persistence, spill publication and I/O deadlines

remaining_boundary: Startup directory/security inventory, quarantine cleanup and lock acquisition remain synchronous; ordinary close lock unlock/descriptor close is outside the serving I/O deadline. In-progress syscalls are never claimed to be cancelled.
